continuity_review.visual_resolution: At normal pet size, 202.5->225 reads as the intended stronger three-quarter rotation rather than a registration jump, and 337.5->000 does not show a conspicuous size pop. The loop remains clockwise, identity-preserving, baseline-stable, and free of reversals or broken attachments.
